title: Establish baseline and current-state architecture audit
description:
Create `docs/audits/current-state-audit.md` before production code changes. This is the factual source of truth for all later work: documentation claims are not evidence, and every defect must be tied to code, a failed test, or a deterministic reproduction.

Record the initial branch, dirty worktree, recent commits, Node/npm/VS Code engine and dependency versions, package manager, lockfile, TypeScript/ESLint/webpack/test configuration, manifest contributions, activation path, and OS-specific assumptions. Run existing scripts exactly as defined; use a temporary checkout for clean install/build/package checks that would otherwise rewrite tracked dependencies or artifacts.

Map extension-host services, React/Zustand state, persistence domains, HTTP execution, commands, lifecycle/disposal, and all webview messages. Include the required message matrix and Mermaid execution/data-flow diagrams. Verify every README/changelog feature against UI wiring, host handling, runtime behavior, and tests. Findings must use the requested ID/severity/status/confidence/evidence/reproduction format and separate bugs, capability gaps, and architectural debt.

checklist.text: Capture branch, worktree, recent commits, repository structure, and pre-existing changes without altering them
Record Node, npm, VS Code engine, dependency, build, lint, TypeScript, test, and OS assumptions
Run clean-install, lint, type-check, build, test, audit, and packaging baselines with exact commands and exit codes
Map activation, commands, webview lifecycle, services, storage, network, state stores, and principal UI flows
Create the complete bidirectional message matrix with validation, response, error, and correlation behavior
Verify README and changelog claims against source, UI wiring, runtime reproductions, and tests
Document every finding in the mandated evidence format and distinguish confirmed, probable, hypothesis, and capability gap
Review the audit for reproducible evidence, severity inflation, duplicate root causes, and missing subsystems
